title: Software Architect – AI & Python
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Software Architect with strong expertise in Python, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to design and deliver scalable, secure, and high-performance software solutions.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining solution architecture, leading technical design decisions, establishing engineering best practices, and guiding development teams in building AI-powered applications and enterprise-grade software systems. This role requires a combination of hands-on technical expertise, architectural leadership, and the ability to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Define and own the end-to-end architecture of software applications and AI-driven solutions.
* Design scalable, modular, secure, and maintainable applications using Python-based technologies.
* Architect AI/ML and Generative AI solutions, including LLM-powered applications, intelligent automation, and enterprise AI integrations.
* Provide technical leadership to Python developers, AI/ML engineers, data scientists, and cross-functional engineering teams.
* Evaluate and select appropriate frameworks, tools, cloud services, databases, and architectural patterns.
* Design and implement RESTful APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and system integrations.
* Guide the development and integration of AI models, vector databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and LLM-based applications.
* Establish coding standards, design principles, documentation practices, and code review processes.
* Ensure application performance, scalability, reliability, security, and data privacy.
* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, and engineering leaders to translate requirements into technical architecture.
* Drive cloud-native architecture, containerisation, CI/CD, and automated deployment practices.
* Assess emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve development efficiency and business outcomes.
* Identify technical risks, architectural bottlenecks, and opportunities for optimisation.
* Support production deployments, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and continuous architectural improvement.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* 10–15 years of experience in software development, solution design, and software architecture.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Python programming and Python-based application development.
* Proven experience designing and delivering scalable enterprise software applications.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI-powered application architecture.
* Experience with Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, or Hugging Face.
* Experience designing REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and application integration solutions.
* Understanding of LLM application development, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and vector databases.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, data modelling, and caching strategies.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and modern DevOps practices.
* Strong understanding of software design patterns, SOLID principles, system design, and performance optimisation.
* Excellent technical leadership, analytical thinking, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience deploying and operating AI-powered applications in production environments.
* Familiarity with MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, evaluation, and lifecycle management.
* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or FAISS.
* Exposure to agentic AI frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangChain or LangGraph.
* Knowledge of AI security, responsible AI practices, access controls, and data governance.
* Experience designing multi-tenant, high-availability, and cloud-native enterprise platforms.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, or AI certifications are an advantage.

Key Competencies

* Software and solution architecture
* Python application engineering
* AI/ML and Generative AI architecture
* System design and scalability
* Cloud-native and distributed systems
* Technical strategy and decision-making
* Engineering standards and code quality

Pay: ₹911,000.00 - ₹3,450,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Software Architect
description:
At Verint, we believe customer engagement is the core of every global brand. Our mission is to help organizations elevate Customer Experience (CX) and increase workforce productivity by delivering CX Automation. We hire innovators with passion, creativity, and drive to answer constantly shifting market challenges and deliver impactful results for our customers. Our commitment to attracting and retaining a talented, diverse, and engaged team creates a collaborative environment that openly celebrates all cultures and affords personal and professional growth opportunities. Learn more at www.verint.com .

**Overview of Job Function:**

As a Software Architect for the WFM/PM platform in India, you will define the technical blueprint for how Verint's engineering team builds, scales, and evolves its Java-based product suite. You will own system-level design decisions, establish cross-cutting architectural standards, and ensure the platform is secure, observable, performant, and maintainable at enterprise scale. You will apply proven software craftsmanship principles — including 12-Factor App methodology, SOLID principles, and design patterns — to guide the team toward a high-quality, long-lived codebase. You will work at the intersection of hands-on technical depth and strategic engineering leadership.

  

**Principal Duties and Essential Responsibilities:**

**1. Architecture and System Design**

* Define and own the technical architecture for WFM, PM, and Platform product areas - spanning Java backend services, frontend systems, APIs, database design, and cloud/on-premises infrastructure.
* Create, maintain, and communicate Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and system design documentation.
* Lead system-level design reviews; enforce architectural governance and review gates for new features and initiatives.
* Apply and enforce 12-Factor App methodology, SOLID principles, and established design patterns across the codebase.
* Design enterprise-grade RESTful API contracts, versioning policies, backward compatibility strategies, and service boundary definitions.
* Architect solutions for both Cloud (AWS/Azure) and On-Premises deployment environments, ensuring consistency and portability.

**2. Java Backend Engineering Excellence**

* Own architectural implementation of Java and Spring Boot microservices, including Spring MVC, JPA/Hibernate, and integration patterns.
* Define and govern database architecture across PostgreSQL, MS SQL, and other relational stores; own schema design, query optimization, stored procedure standards, and indexing strategy.
* Establish standards for unit and integration testing using PowerMock, Mockito, and JUnit; define test coverage thresholds and enforcement mechanisms.
* Evaluate and govern usage of build tools including Gradle, Maven, and npm; define dependency management and versioning standards.
* Champion secure-by-design practices aligned with OWASP Top 10 and enterprise customer security requirements.

**3. Frontend and Full-Stack Oversight**

* Define frontend architecture standards for ReactJS-based applications, including component design, state management, and performance optimization.
* Govern integration patterns between backend Java services and frontend applications, including API design, authentication (OAuth 2.0/JWT), and error handling.
* Provide architectural guidance on NodeJS services where applicable, including integration with Java backend systems.
* Ensure accessibility, internationalisation (i18n), and cross-browser compatibility are considered in frontend architecture decisions.

**4. DevOps, CI/CD, and Operational Excellence**

* Define CI/CD pipeline architecture using Jenkins and other DevOps tooling; establish standards for automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
* Own deployment architecture for application server environments including Tomcat, JBoss, and Oracle WebLogic Server (14+).
* Establish observability architecture: logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting standards for both cloud and on-premises deployments.
* Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets; lead post-incident architecture reviews and drive systemic reliability improvements.

**5. Technical Standards, Governance, and Mentorship**

* Define and own engineering standards: coding guidelines, testing strategy, performance benchmarks, scripting conventions (Python, Shell, Batch), and security requirements.
* Establish and maintain the technology radar; govern adoption of third-party libraries, frameworks, and tools.
* Own the technical debt roadmap; prioritize and sequence refactoring and modernization initiatives.
* Serve as the architectural mentor for Senior and Lead engineers; enable the team to make sound design decisions independently.
* Facilitate architecture guilds, design sprints, and tech talks to elevate team-wide architectural thinking.

**6. Cross-Functional and Global Collaboration**

* Partner with global R&D leadership, Product, and Engineering leaders in UK and the US to align architecture with product strategy.
* Provide architectural input into roadmap planning, make-vs-buy evaluations, and platform investment decisions.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders including Product, Customer Success, and executive audiences.
* Engage directly with customers and enterprise stakeholders on production issues requiring architectural-level analysis and resolution.

  

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* 12+ years of professional software engineering with 3+ years in a dedicated architecture, principal engineer, or technical lead role.
* B.E. / B.Tech. / M.Tech. / M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related STEM field.
* Equivalent exceptional practical experience with a demonstrable architectural portfolio will be considered.
* Demonstrable record of architecting large-scale, multi-tenant enterprise Java applications serving enterprise customers.
* Experience driving architecture across distributed, cross-timezone engineering organizations.

  **Technical Skills:**
* Back-End: Expert-level Java and Spring Boot (Spring MVC, JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security). Deep expertise in RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Frontend: Strong architectural knowledge of ReactJS. Familiarity with Angular and NodeJS.
* Databases: Expert-level PostgreSQL and MS SQL relational database architecture. Deep SQL query optimization, stored procedure design, schema migration, and indexing strategy.
* Application Servers: Oracle WebLogic Server (14+), Tomcat, and JBoss/WildFly.
* Build and Tooling: Gradle, Maven, npm. IDE expertise with IntelliJ IDEA and Eclipse.
* Testing: Expert-level JUnit, Mockito, PowerMock, and integration testing strategy.
* Scripting: Python, Shell Script, and Batch Script for automation and operational tooling.
* Cloud and Infrastructure: AWS or Azure architecture. Docker and Kubernetes. IaC fundamentals (Terraform or CloudFormation).
* CI/CD: Jenkins pipeline architecture and CI/CD platform design.

  **Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications:**
* Experience in WFM, PM, or enterprise analytics SaaS domains.
* Familiarity with Verint WFO, PM product architecture.
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional or Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification.
* Experience with TOGAF, C4 model, or equivalent architectural frameworks.
* Contributions to open-source projects or published technical content.
* Knowledge of regulatory compliance architecture (GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001).

title: Sr Principal Architect : Ads Platform
description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Advertising makes billions of decisions every day across search, native, shopping, display, audience, and AI-powered advertising experiences.

We are looking for a **Principal Software Architect** to define the technical direction for **Ads Quality** at global scale.

Quality decisions can depend on ads, landing pages, advertisers, businesses, account history, behavioral patterns, and signals that may be incomplete, delayed, noisy, or changing. The challenge is to turn this evidence into systems that are accurate, scalable, measurable, and continuously improving.

This is a hands-on software engineering role spanning distributed systems, production AI, decision systems, entity intelligence, agentic workflows, and measurement.

 **Responsibilities**

Define the long-term architecture for Ads Quality across signals, entity understanding, model execution, decisioning, feedback, and measurement.

Establish how quality systems should reason across ads, landing pages, advertisers, businesses, relationships, and behavior over time.

Design architectures that support heterogeneous AI systems including lightweight models, multimodal models, LLMs, agents, and deterministic systems.

Define how evidence, model outputs, confidence, calibration, thresholds, and decision policies come together in production.

Set technical direction across real-time, nearline, and offline systems, balancing quality, latency, freshness, cost, and reliability.

Drive convergence where common abstractions create leverage and challenge unnecessary duplication or complexity.

Partner with Applied Science on how new model capabilities should shape system architecture.

Prototype difficult ideas when that is the fastest way to establish technical feasibility.

Influence implementation through design reviews, architecture guidance, and hands-on engagement with critical systems.

 **Qualifications**

15+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent technical depth.

Deep experience architecting large-scale production systems spanning multiple teams.

Strong expertise in distributed systems, production AI/ML systems, decision systems, or large-scale data platforms.

Strong understanding of model serving, experimentation, evaluation, observability, rollout, and feedback loops.

Ability to reason across software architecture and model behavior without treating ML as a black box.

Track record of simplifying complex systems and turning ambiguous technical problems into durable architecture.

Ability to influence senior engineers and technical leaders across organizational boundaries.

Experience with advertising, quality systems, entity intelligence, multimodal AI, agentic systems, behavioral systems, or large-scale inference is valuable.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. title: MF Platform Support-Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role
  
Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  
  
In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  
  
What you will do

* Diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure issues across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems by identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions.
* Design, deploy, and integrate end-to-end infrastructure solutions across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments to ensure seamless operations.
* Automate workflows, processes, and system tasks to improve reliability, efficiency, scalability, and operational consistency.
* Assess technical risks proactively and implement preventive measures to minimize disruptions and maintain business continuity.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Architects, Project Managers, and technical specialists, to deliver successful project outcomes.
* Lead infrastructure projects from planning through execution, ensuring high-quality delivery within agreed timelines and customer expectations.
* Communicate technical solutions and architecture recommendations effectively to customers and stakeholders, building trust through measurable business impact.
Continuously expand expertise in cloud technologies, enterprise IT systems, and emerging technologies while pursuing professional certifications and career growth opportunities.  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important-you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused-someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless-naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

Required skills and experience
  

* 8+ years of experience and deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics)
* Enterprise IT application experience
* Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain
* In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System

  
Preferred skills and experience
  

* Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures
* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models
* Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems
* Analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Principal Engineer-Verification
description:
Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc.

People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the *Aggregate System* and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence.

Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you.

Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!

**Job Description:**

Microchip’s Communications Business Unit (CBU) develops high-performance networking, connectivity, and edge compute semiconductor solutions that power communications infrastructure, data centers, automotive systems, aerospace and defense platforms, and industrial applications. Our global team works across the full product lifecycle to deliver innovative products that enable the world’s most demanding connected systems.

The CBU Product Development team is engaged throughout the device R&D cycle, from concept and design through implementation. Once a prototype is available, we support embedded software development and system-validation lab testing through mass-market production release. Our experienced chip-development team uses the latest semiconductor tools and methodologies, together with advanced process technologies, to develop state-of-the-art networking devices.

As a Principal Engineer on the CBU Product Development team, you will be responsible for verifying digital integrated circuits at the block or device level. You will collaborate with chip architects, subsystem leads, and verification team members to deliver increasingly complex designs in a friendly, professional environment.

**The role of the Principal Engineer includes:**
------------------------------------------------

* **Verification**
  ----------------

  + Own the verification of complex digital integrated circuits at the block, subsystem, or device level.
  + Understand the device requirements and functional description to ensure compliance with specifications and error-free operation.
  + Plan verification activities, develop testbenches, and execute tests.
  + Develop verification platforms using the UVM methodology and SystemVerilog.
* **Technical Leadership**
  ------------------------

  + Deliver verified designs at the Device, Subsystem or Block level
  + Partner with a dedicated Design Lead to deliver high-confidence designs
  + Verify designs implemented in SystemVerilog RTL using industry-standard methodologies.
* **Domain Expertise**
  --------------------

  + Contribute to the development and enhancement of verification technologies and methodologies.
* **Cross Functional Responsibility**
  -----------------------------------

  + Collaborate with Software and Validation teams to deliver devices that integrate into a wider system.
  + Participate in Product Validation during the prototype stage of development.

**Requirements/Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
* 8+ years related experience
* Excellent analytical and debugging skills and the ability to proactively solve issues
* Proven ability to thrive on, learn and adapt to new methodologies and technologies
* Strong coding skills
* Experience using one or more of System Verilog/Verilog/VHDL, Tcl/Perl/Python, C/C++
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Experience with verification methodologies, including UVM, formal verification, and constrained-random verification.

**Travel Time:**

0% - 25%

* Certified Salesforce Platform Dev II.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As an Application Engineer Salesforce at YouTube, you will be a part of the salesforce-focused engineering team building business systems for the YouTube GTMS T&I Partnership Systems team that is tasked with achieving greater creator satisfaction and success.

Your work enables our partnership teams to provide strategic, outcomes-focused insights for our top YouTube creators. Outcomes of the team keep the YouTube business organization nimble, able to understand partner needs and innovate accordingly.

title: SQA Manager
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

Gallagher Center of Excellence is seeking a Senior QA Engineer with 10–15 years of relevant experience to lead quality engineering for Gallagher Drive analytics products. The role will define and govern the QA strategy across Power BI reports and dashboards, data and ETL pipelines, APIs, and supporting applications. The Senior QA Engineer will provide hands-on technical leadership, establish repeatable QA processes and controls, guide automation architecture using Python, PyTest, and Playwright, drive risk-based release readiness, mentor QA resources, and partner with business, product, development, data, and reporting leaders. This is a senior technical individual-contributor role; direct people-management responsibility should be confirmed separately by the hiring manager.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

* **QA Strategy and Governance:** Define the end-to-end quality strategy, operating model, risk-based test approach, entry and exit criteria, evidence standards, release gates, sign-off controls, SOPs, checklists, and regression governance across analytics products.
* **Test Leadership and Assurance:** Lead planning and assurance for functional, integration, system, regression, data, API, ETL, reporting, smoke, performance, security-related, and release validation; ensure appropriate coverage across critical business journeys.
* **Power BI Quality Engineering:** Establish testing standards for data accuracy, DAX calculations, semantic models, filters, slicers, interactions, drill-through, navigation, refresh behavior, role-based access, visual standards, accessibility, and performance.
* **Data and ETL Quality Leadership:** Define source-to-target reconciliation controls and data-quality rules across source systems, ETL pipelines, Snowflake or equivalent warehouse layers, semantic models, and reporting outputs.
* **Automation Strategy and Architecture:** Define scalable automation architecture using Python, PyTest, Playwright, API frameworks, reusable libraries, test-data utilities, reporting, and CI/CD integration. Prioritize automation based on risk, business value, repeatability, effort, and maintainability.
* **Visual Regression and Baseline Governance:** Establish Playwright or comparable browser automation for Power BI navigation, screenshot capture, visual comparison, threshold management, approved baseline updates, and defect triage for unexpected changes.
* **Azure DevOps Traceability and Controls:** Establish requirements-to-test-to-defect traceability, evidence standards, dashboards, workflow controls, defect templates, and execution reporting in Azure DevOps or an approved comparable tool.
* **Defect Governance and Root Cause Analysis:** Lead defect triage, severity and priority alignment, defect-ageing reviews, root-cause analysis, corrective-action tracking, fix verification, and learning from escaped defects.
* **Release Readiness and Executive Reporting:** Provide concise decision-oriented reporting on requirements and test coverage, execution progress, defect trends, open high-severity risks, automation coverage, dependencies, residual exposure, and release recommendations.
* **Cross-Functional Quality Leadership:** Partner with product owners, business analysts, engineering leaders, data engineers, Power BI developers, architects, scrum masters, security teams, and business stakeholders to make requirements testable and address quality risks early.
* **Capability Building and Knowledge Sustainability:** Mentor QA engineers, conduct reviews, define reusable templates and assets, maintain current operating procedures, facilitate knowledge transfer, improve backup readiness, and reduce dependency on individual subject-matter experts.
* **Continuous Improvement and Innovation:** Use quality metrics, defect patterns, delivery retrospectives, and value-stream analysis to identify process improvements. Evaluate AI-assisted testing, specification-driven approaches, and new tooling through governed proofs of concept.
* **Compliance, Security and Test Data:** Ensure QA practices follow approved privacy, masking, access-control, environment, open-source package, and secure test-data requirements.
* **Stakeholder and Delivery Management:** Manage competing QA priorities across products, communicate trade-offs and resource constraints, escalate blockers early, and align testing investment with customer and business outcomes.

  
  
**About you**

**Qualifications:**

* 10–15 years of software quality assurance experience, including technical leadership for complex data, analytics, reporting, API, and application testing.
* Demonstrated experience defining QA strategy, governance, standards, entry and exit criteria, evidence expectations, release gates, and sign-off recommendations.
* Advanced SQL and data-validation capability covering reconciliation, profiling, joins, aggregations, transformation-rule validation, and investigation of data discrepancies.
* Strong Power BI quality-assurance experience covering DAX, semantic models, data, interactions, role-based access, refresh, performance, visual standards, and regression governance.
* Strong data and ETL testing experience with Snowflake, Azure Synapse, SQL Server, SSMS, ADF, or comparable cloud data platforms and pipeline technologies.
* Hands-on Python and PyTest experience, including reusable framework design, fixtures, utilities, assertions, reporting, and automation maintainability.
* Experience with Playwright or a comparable browser automation framework for UI and visual regression testing and baseline governance.
* Experience with API testing, CI/CD integration, source control, automated execution reporting, and controlled adoption of open-source packages.
* Advanced Azure DevOps experience for test management, requirements traceability, defect governance, dashboards, sprint visibility, and quality reporting.
* Experience leading defect triage, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, release-readiness reviews, and executive or leadership-level quality reporting.
* Ability to mentor QA engineers, influence without formal authority, lead cross-functional quality discussions, and create sustainable knowledge-transfer practices.
* Strong business acumen, strategic communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, analytical thinking, and evidence-based decision-making.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience establishing or scaling a QA Center of Excellence or shared quality-engineering capability.
* Experience with AI-assisted testing, specification-driven test generation, automated defect creation, or governed use of enterprise AI platforms.
* Performance testing experience using JMeter, k6, or comparable tools; accessibility testing knowledge is an advantage.
* Knowledge of data lineage, metadata, observability, data contracts, masking, access controls, and secure non-production environments.
* Experience measuring automation return, manual-effort reduction, defect leakage, coverage, cycle time, and release confidence.
* ISTQB Advanced/Test Manager, CSQE, Microsoft Power BI, Snowflake, Azure, Python, Agile/Scrum, Lean Six Sigma, or related certification or training.

**Education And Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, data, or a related technical discipline is preferred.
* 10–15 years of relevant QA experience. Talent Acquisition and Compensation should confirm the final career level, career band, and education wording before publication.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

Hevo's platform moves and transforms data for thousands of customers, around the clock. We're looking for a Staff Platform Engineer to own the reliability, scalability, and observability of the infrastructure that makes that possible — a senior, hands-on engineer who can both operate at depth in AWS and Kubernetes and set technical direction for the broader Platform/DevOps function.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own end-to-end reliability, scalability, and performance of Hevo's production infrastructure on AWS, GCP and Kubernetes
* Design and evolve our observability stack — metrics, logs, traces, alerting, SLIs/SLOs, and error budgets
* Lead incident management: on-call rotations, blameless postmortems, and systematically reducing MTTA/MTTR
* Drive infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform, Ansible) and own CI/CD pipeline design
* Architect and operate Kubernetes clusters at scale — upgrades, autoscaling, cost optimization, multi-tenant workloads
* Own network architecture and security posture for cloud infrastructure (VPCs, load balancers, service mesh, zero-trust networking)
* Partner with product engineering teams to embed reliability and operational excellence into the software lifecycle
* Mentor and uplevel other platform engineers; set technical direction and engineering best practices
* Own capacity planning and cost optimization for cloud infrastructure

### **What We're Looking For — Must-Haves**

* 8+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform engineering roles, including meaningful time operating at Staff/Lead level
* Deep, hands-on expertise running production Kubernetes at scale
* Strong AWS expertise (EC2, VPC, EKS, RDS, IAM, networking, security groups)
* Proven track record building observability stacks (OTel, Grafana, Telegraf, Influx or similar)
* Strong scripting/automation skills (Python, Go, or Bash)
* Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform, Ansible)
* CI/CD pipeline design and ownership (Jenkins or similar)
* Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, VPNs, service mesh
* Experience owning on-call/incident management and driving a strong postmortem culture
* Excellent communication skills — able to influence engineering decisions across teams without direct authority

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with multi-region or multi-cloud architectures
* Familiarity with cost optimization / FinOps practices
* Exposure to compliance-driven environments (SOC 2, GDPR)
* Prior experience at a SaaS or data infrastructure company

--------------

Hevo is a fully-managed, no-code data pipeline platform that helps organizations move, transform, and activate their data in real time. With 150+ pre-built, battle-tested connectors, Hevo lets data teams focus on insights instead of pipeline maintenance — trusted by 2,000+ organizations globally to keep their data flowing reliably, securely, and in compliance with standards like SOC 2, GDPR, and HIPAA.

title: Senior Mainframe CICS Support, Systems Administration
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

The Mainframe CICS Support System Adminstrator role ensures the availability, stability, performance, and resiliency of mission-critical transaction processing systems supporting enterprise business operations. The position requires strong technical expertise in CICS infrastructure, problem determination, performance tuning, incident resolution, and change implementation within a complex 24x7 mainframe environment.

  

**Responsibilities**

* **Administration:** Install, configure, upgrade, and manage IBM CICS software, startup procedures, and resource definitions on z/OS.
* **Performance & Monitoring:** Continuously monitor CICS regions, tune performance, and balance workloads to ensure high availability.
* **Troubleshooting & Analysis:** Resolve incidents and service outages using CICS dumps, traces, logs, and root cause analysis (RCA).
* **Application & Team Support:** Assist application teams with CICS deployments and collaborate with z/OS, DB2, MQ, Storage, Network, and Security teams.
* **Operations & Compliance:** Manage change controls, documentation, disaster recovery testing, audit compliance, on-call rotations, and task automation.

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* **Experience & Mainframe Core:** 5+ years of hands-on experience supporting IBM CICS Transaction Server environments along with a strong foundation in z/OS operating systems.
* **Architecture & System Configuration:** In-depth knowledge of CICS architecture, region management, RDO, SIT parameters, and system initialization processes.
* **Production Troubleshooting & Analysis:** Strong problem-resolution skills with hands-on experience analyzing CICS dumps, traces, logs, and performance metrics in high-volume production environments.
* **Operational Processes:** Practical experience with change, incident, and problem management frameworks in high-availability systems.

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.
* Experience with CICS Transaction Server version upgrades, migrations, CICSplex SM, CPSM, and dynamic workload routing.
* Expertise in monitoring, tuning, and troubleshooting CICS performance using tools like IBM OMEGAMON, CICS PA, MainView, or Sysview.
* Working knowledge of related middleware technologies (DB2, MQ, IMS) and mainframe security administration using RACF.
Hands-on experience with disaster recovery execution, automated scripting, ITIL processes, and supporting 24x7 globally distributed production environments.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Job Description:**

**Lead Engineer - Methods & Tools**

  

**Team: Airbus India - Engineering Methods & Tools**

  

**About the team:**

  

We are a transverse team working with different core engineering verticals in Airbus. The USP of this team is working in a multi-functional environment providing digital solutions to engineering problems. The team is composed of people with Core Engineering domain knowledge complemented by software development skills. The team plays an enabler role in various digitization initiatives across Airbus utilizing the latest technologies and the domain knowledge they have.

  

We are seeking a **Senior Java Developer** with 7+ years of core software engineering experience and a background in **electrical engineering or aerospace domains** . In this role, you will design, customize, and build advanced software solutions and tools, with a focus on electrical harness design and systems integration. Hands-on product development or integration experience with **Siemens Capital** (formerly Mentor Graphics Capital) is strongly preferred.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Software Architecture & Development:** Design, build, and optimize backend Java applications, microservices, and custom extensions for complex electrical system design platforms.
* **Siemens Capital Integration:** Develop custom plugins, custom actions, data bridges, and automation rules using the **Siemens Capital API** (Capital Logic, Capital Harness XC, Capital Enterprise Integrator).
* **Domain Modeling:** Translate complex electrical harness structures, wiring schematics, pinouts, and EWIS (Electrical Wiring Interconnection System) rules into robust, scalable software models.
* **System Interoperability:** Build APIs and integration pipelines between ECAD software, MCAD platforms (e.g., CATIA, Siemens NX), and PLM systems (e.g., Teamcenter, Enovia).
* **Technical Leadership:** Conduct code reviews, establish best practices for Java and API development, and collaborate with cross-functional aerospace/electrical engineering teams.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Minimum 7 years of professional software development experience in Java/J2EE within electrical, aerospace, defense, or automotive engineering environments.
* **Core Technical Stack:** Advanced proficiency in **Core Java** (Java 11+, object-oriented architecture, multi-threading, RESTful APIs, design patterns).Deep experience with enterprise Java frameworks (Spring Boot, Hibernate/JPA, Maven/Gradle).
* **Domain Expertise:** Solid understanding of electrical wiring schematics, harness layout, pin-to-pin connectivity, or aerospace EWIS standards.
* **Platform Expertise:** Hands-on development experience with **Siemens Capital** suite (Capital Logic, Harness XC, Systems Architect) and its custom plugin/API ecosystem.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development practices, Git, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

title: IS&T Software Engineering Solutions Architect
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

Could you be the full-time IS&T Software Engineering Solutions Architect in our IS&T D&IS Software Engineering Solutions team we’re looking for?

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your technical prowess in software development lifecycle. You’ll work alongside innovative, diligent, and supportive teammates.

You'll act as a control tower to ensure overall consistency in our application landscape. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (architecture, design, implementation, and support), maintain technical solution documentation, and much more.

You’ll specifically take care of providing technical and domain expertise on complex topics, as well as leading technical design and architecture.

We’ll look to you for:

* Collect, challenge, clarify and manage demands from central Business and stakeholders
* Ensure alignment with Corporate Strategies & official Business Processes
* Participate to the Software Engineering roadmap and align it with the global Digital Transformation roadmap
* Prepare architecture recommendations and decision inputs for governance and Change Control Boards
* Model & maintain functional and technical architecture, solutions referential, standards and design documentation of the domain
* Promote Alstom Core Model by leading evolution and ensuring its consistency
* Contribute to all phases of applications lifecycle from definition, architecture, design trough implementation, debugging, testing and early support
* Contribute to Business Processes development and improvement through technology watch
* Provide technical and domain expertise on complex topics and lead technical proofs of concept
* Build best practices and continuous improvement on development activities
* Provide technical and domain expertise on complex topics and lead technical proofs of concept
* Analyse technology industry and business trends and determine their potential applicability at Alstom
* Guide responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering across the SDLC, with appropriate quality, security, traceability and value controls

  

**All about you**

We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* A degree in Engineering or equivalent higher education, preferably in information technology, computer science or software engineering.
* Over all 9+years of Experience in in software or solution architecture covering various roles (business / functional architecture / development/customization, deployment, ownership in complex environments)
* Solid knowledge of software engineering processes: requirements, architecture, development, configuration management, build, release, verification, validation and support
* Deep knowledge of software version control and configuration management, CI/CD, build and release automation, artifact management, quality gates and DevSecOps practices
* Proven architecture skills covering functional and technical design, integration patterns, APIs, automation, scalability, resilience, observability and lifecycle management
* Background and appetite for responsible AI applied to the SDLC
* Strong development and scripting skills in several languages (Perl, Python, etc) with experience in bespoke application development
* General knowledge of IT infrastructure systems: Azure, Linux, Windows, virtualization, servers, databases, networks and storage
* Technical knowledge of IBM Jazz ELM, ClearCase, ClearQuest or Synergy administration, architecture and customization is considered a plus
* Ability to address application security vulnerabilities and apply secure-by-design principles
* Experience working for global companies as a service provider or customer, ideally in both roles
* Very strong technical leadership and business-value orientation
* Deep interest or knowledge on engineering solutions (especially in railway and safety context) regarding architecture and development/customization
* Good communication, efficiency and ability to execute. You are result oriented and show intellectual curiosity and creativity

  

**Things you’ll enjoy**

Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our dynamic working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
* Progress towards senior technical and management roles
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

  

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. **What You Can Expect**

* Drive the implementation of IAM technical architecture, with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud as the core governance platform, creating reference architectures aligned with security posture, and operational efficiency.
* Drive the integration of AI assisted IAM capabilities to improve decision quality, reduce manual effort, risk and champion use cases such as:
  + Intelligent access recommendations
  + Role and entitlement optimization
  + Risk based certification prioritization
  + Identity anomaly and outlier detection
* Make high impact technical decisions in areas of ambiguity, balancing risk, and scale.
* Lead the design and evolution of SailPoint ISC implementations, including identity lifecycle automation, access governance, role models, certifications, and integrations.
* Set engineering standards for rules, transforms, workflows, REST/SCIM integrations, and connector patterns.
* Drive reliability and scale of JML processes, ensuring strong controls, observability, and operational resilience.
* Architect and mature RBAC and entitlement-based governance models, including SoD and policy-driven access controls.

* Evaluate emerging vendor capabilities and influence platform adoption decisions with a long-term, architectural mindset.
* Serve as a trusted technical partner to application teams, infrastructure, security leadership, and audit stakeholders.

----------------------------

* Experience with Salesforce Platform Events, Change Data Capture, asynchronous Apex, middleware, or event-driven integrations.
* Experience with observability, service-level indicators and objectives, incident management, root-cause analysis, and operational readiness reviews.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments such as Scrum or Kanban.

description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**LEAD PLATFORM EMULATION ENGINEER:**  
  
**THE ROLE:**

The focus of this role is to plan, build, execute the verification, validation/emulation and debug of new and existing features for AMD’s SOCs, resulting in no bugs in the final SOC design and the firmware/BIOS. This senior role will stretch you as you lead emulation team in new directions, network with our world-class, patent-holding think-tank, and negotiate amongst design teams, marketing, and business unit executives.  
  
**THE PERSON:**

You have a passion for modern, complex processor architecture, digital design, and verification/debugging in general. You are a team player who has experience collaborating with other engineers located in different sites/timezones. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and are willing to learn and ready to take on problems

You have excellent communication and presentation skills, demonstrated through technical publications, presentations, trainings, executive briefings, etc. You are highly adept at collaboration among top-thinkers and engineers alike, ready to mentor and guide, and help to elevate the knowledge and skills of the team around you.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* Collaborate with architects, hardware engineers, and firmware engineers to understand the new features to be verified
* Drive Emulation Methodologies, SOC Design Model and Test Architecture for full chip SOC and hybrid models
* Build test plan documentation, accounting for interactions with other features, the hardware, the firmware, and the software driver use cases
* Estimate the time required to write the new feature tests and any required changes to the test environment
* Build the directed Pre-Silicon Emulation tests
* Debug test failures to determine the root cause; work with RTL and firmware engineers to resolve design defects and correct any test or infra issues
* Responsible for writing directed tests to verify features in a co-simulated and emulated/FPGA hardware environment
* Responsible for writing monitors and checkers to support end-to-end firmware/hardware validation
* Responsible for running emulator workloads to test new features and debug technical issues using logs, waveform dumps and RTL debug
* Use AI for hardware debug, improve execution and emulation capacity efficiency and automation

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

  

* Must have exposure to SOC architecture (preferred X86)
* Experience with BIOS/OS bring up on full X86 SOC emulation platform

* Proficient in IP level ASIC verification, experience working with CPU, GPU, and Memory subsystem
* Proficient in debugging firmware and RTL code using simulation tools
* Good understanding of PCIe/USB/Ethernet standards; safety concepts/IPs
* Must have hands-on experience on Zebu/Palladium/Veloce platform to bring-up SOC
* SOC design model build experience
* Experienced with Verilog, System Verilog, C, and C++
* Experience in writing and debugging testbenches
* Scripting language experience: Perl, Ruby, Makefile, shell preferred
* Experience on debugging SOC IO interfaces with Transactor solutions in Emulation platform
* Think differently and out of the box to stress the DUT in Emulation platform and verify it in efficient way
* Should be open to learning verification methodologies and working closely with design, verification, validation, architecture and firmware teams
* Excellent communication, management, and presentation skills
* Adept at collaboration among top-thinkers and senior architects with strong interpersonal skills to work across teams in different geographies

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer/Electronics/Electrical Engineering with 18+ years of experience

title: Technical Trainer / Certified Instructor (VCI) – VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF)
description:
**Please Note:**

**1. If you are a first time user, please create your candidate login account before you apply for a job.**

**2. If you already have a Candidate Account, please Sign-In before you apply.**

**Job Description:**
--------------------

Position Summary & Purpose:

We are seeking an experienced VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) Technical Trainer to deliver enterprise-level Instructor-Led Training (ILT) and Virtual Instructor-Led Training (vILT).

This is a core instruction role designed for a hands-on technical facilitator who can step directly into the classroom as a Lead Instructor with minimal ramp-up time. While the primary mission is active classroom teaching (~70% estimated delivery focus), the instructor will also lend non-delivery bandwidth to partner with the Business Unit (BU) on curriculum review and content feedback.

Note on Role Scope: This is a customer-facing, delivery-first instructor position. Candidates coming from a dedicated curriculum design background should note that live teaching and lab facilitation form the primary core of this role.  
Key Responsibilities

  

* Live Technical Instruction & Facilitation (Primary Role):  
  Serve as a Lead Instructor delivering high-touch ILT and vILT sessions to enterprise customer teams, engineers, and administrators.  
  Facilitate complex hands-on lab exercises, run live technical demonstrations, and navigate unscripted, deep-dive Q&A with authority.  
  Troubleshoot live lab environments and technical edge cases during active training delivery.
* BU Collaboration & Curriculum Support:  
  Lend subject matter expertise to the Business Unit (BU) during non-teaching windows to assist with courseware development, lab topology review, and student guide updates.  
  Channel real-world classroom feedback and student insights directly back to the BU to keep training aligned with field needs.  
  Help establish delivery best practices and assist in onboarding guest or peer instructors.
* Onsite Delivery:  
  Travel to customer sites or corporate events for onsite classroom training as required.

Core Technical Domain Requirements

  

* VCF Platform Architecture: Multi-domain architecture, deployment, full-stack lifecycle management, and Day-2 operational strategies.
* Compute & Virtualization: vSphere, ESXi host tuning, vCenter Server, cluster management, high availability (HA), DRS, and workload lifecycle operations.
* SDDC Management & Domains: VCF management domains, workload domains, SDDC Manager / VCF management services, and upgrades.
* Software-Defined Networking & Security: VMware NSX ecosystem, including virtual routing and switching, micro-segmentation, and security concepts.
* Software-Defined Storage: VMware vSAN architecture, storage policy-based management (SPBM), resilience, and operations.
* Operations & Automation:  
  Infrastructure monitoring, performance management, log analytics, and capacity management.  
  Self-service automation concepts, governance frameworks, and API integrations.
* Cloud-Native Concepts: Modern Kubernetes concepts on VCF, including Supervisor services and Tanzu / VCF Kubernetes Services (VKS).
* Enterprise Infrastructure: DNS, NTP, certificates/PKI, identity, security, and high availability.

Qualifications & Credentials

  

* Certifications:  
  Current VCI (VMware Certified Instructor) status strongly preferred.  
  Active VCP or higher advanced VMware credential preferred/required.
* Professional Experience:  
  Hands-on experience operating, implementing, or engineering VCF environments.  
  Background as a VCI, authorized technical instructor, Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Lead.
* Customer Presentation Skills:

description:
**Company Description**

As Japan’s semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real‑world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence. Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division’s (India for India) mission is to grow India market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications.

 **Job Description**  

* Be a part of end‑to‑end verification execution for SOC owning complex digital IP’s and subsystems from specification to sign‑off
* Define and drive IP‑level verification strategies, including test plans, coverage models, and closure criteria

* Lead functional, code, assertion, and cross‑coverage closure, ensuring high‑quality sign‑off with clear metrics

* Ensure IP deliverables meet quality, schedule, and reusability expectations for SoC integration.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electronics Engineering
* 1 - 2 years of experience in SoC Verification domains and have working knowledge of industry standard EDA toolkits.
* Strong expertise in UVM‑based testbench architecture and development
* Proven experience in metric‑driven verification, including functional and code coverage closure
* Deep understanding of SystemVerilog, UVM, assertions (SVA), and verification best practices
* Experience with directed and constrained‑random verification methodologies
* Experience debugging complex design issues in simulation, emulation, and post‑silicon environments
* Proficiency in Verilog/SystemVerilog, with working knowledge of C/C++, Shell scripting
* Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills

**Preferred/Plus Qualifications**

Hands‑on experience using AI/ML‑based verification tools for:

* Coverage gap analysis
* Test stimulus optimization
* Regression triage and coverage acceleration
* Scripting expertise in Python, Perl, or TCL for automation and analytics
* Exposure to formal verification and hybrid formal‑simulation flows
* Familiarity with high‑speed or complex IPs, such as:
* H.264
* Security, debug, or safety‑crititical

  
**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a highly skilled and forward-thinking AI Solutions Architect to lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI solutions powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). This role demands hands on expertise in designing scalable AI architectures, integrating cutting-edge tools, and ensuring safety, observability, and performance at scale. This role also requires collaboration with engineering leads to drive AI innovation/ discussion, drive technical decisions, ensure delivery ownerships and include Gen AI capabilities in the existing product roadmaps/ frameworks.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in Software engineering, AI/ML systems, system/ solution engineering, distributed architecture, and platform design, along with recent hands-on work in Generative AI, multi-agent systems, LAG/RAG pipelines, and AI governance. You should be equally comfortable reviewing legacy software architectures, mentoring engineers, working with cross-functional stakeholders, and driving production readiness of AI systems.

Key Responsibilities :-

AI Platform Architecture: Design and own the end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI systems spanning LLM orchestration, multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM gateways, and API layers. Define reference architectures, design patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Tool-Use), and enforce architectural standards through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems: Architect and implement production multi-agent systems with specialized agents (content generation, compliance auditing, data retrieval, orchestration), inter-agent communication protocols, tool/function calling frameworks, plugin registries, and memory management (conversation buffers, working memory, long-term vector stores). Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints, fallback chains, and graceful degradation patterns.

Production RAG Systems: Design production-grade RAG pipelines including document ingestion (PDF, DOCX, HTML with tables, images, multi-column layouts), chunking strategies (recursive, semantic, document-structure-aware, parent-child), hybrid retrieval (semantic + BM25 + metadata filtering), re-ranking, query analysis/rewriting, citation enforcement, and hallucination detection.

LLM Strategy & Model Routing: Define multi-provider LLM strategies across Claude (Anthropic), GPT-4o (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), and open-source models (Llama, Mistral). Architect intelligent model routing that optimizes for cost, latency, and capability. Evaluate and recommend models for specific use cases based on capability fit, context window, compliance, and deployment constraints.

LLMOps & AgentOps: Build CI/CD pipelines for AI systems prompt versioning and regression testing, automated evaluation suites (RAGAS, LLM-as-Judge), model A/B testing, and staged rollouts. Design observability infrastructure with full execution tracing, token tracking, cost attribution, latency SLAs, and quality dashboards using AgentOps, LangSmith, Langfuse or OpenTelemetry.

Evaluation & Quality Assurance: Design multi-layered evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics (RAGAS, BLEU, ROUGE), LLM-as-Judge pipelines with bias mitigation, embedding-based similarity, and domain-expert human review. Build and maintain golden test datasets (500+ curated QA pairs). Define monitoring for retrieval health, hallucination rates, empty retrieval rates, and user satisfaction.

Explainable AI (XAI): Implement explainability at multiple levels input attribution (RAG citations with chunk-level source mapping), reasoning traces (structured Chain-of-Thought with audit trails), confidence calibration, uncertainty quantification, and contrastive explanations. Produce model cards, data sheets, and system documentation for regulatory compliance.

Responsible AI & Governance: Establish and lead the Responsible AI program including guardrail architecture (input/processing/output guardrails with declarative configuration), bias detection and fairness evaluation pipelines, red-teaming exercises (prompt injection, data poisoning, adversarial attacks), AI security measures, PII redaction, privacy-by-design, and regulatory compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, FDA AI/ML guidance, GDPR/CCPA).

Strategic Leadership: Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Business, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders to translate requirements into AI roadmaps. Mentor a team of 20+ engineers through design reviews, technical coaching, and career development. Drive build-vs-buy-vs-open-source decisions and present technical strategy to executive leadership.

Technical Skills :-

Languages & Frameworks: Expert Python; proficient JavaScript/TypeScript. FastAPI, Flask, or Django for backend APIs. ReactJS or Streamlit for AI interfaces.

LLM & Agent Frameworks: Microsoft Agent framework, AutoGen, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Strands Agents, Semantic Kernel. Deep knowledge of ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, and Tool-Use orchestration patterns.

Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB) and/or Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Studio, Cognitive Services). Multi-cloud experience preferred.

Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector, ChromaDB, or Milvus in production environments.

Document Processing: Azure Document Intelligence, PyMuPDF, Unstructured.io, LlamaParse. Experience with tables, images, and complex PDF/DOCX extraction.

Data & Storage: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch. Data modeling for AI-driven applications.

Observability & MLOps: AgentOps, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, Weights & Biases. CI/CD for AI (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

LLM Gateway: LiteLLM, Portkey, or custom gateway development for multi-model routing, rate limiting, and cost tracking

Key Competencies :-

Strong architectural thinking with the ability to balance scalability, simplicity, cost, speed, and risk.

Strong people leadership and mentoring capability.

Ability to drive delivery while maintaining technical quality.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability in ambiguous environments.

High ownership mindset with focus on business impact and production outcomes.

Commitment to responsible, secure, and ethical AI adoption.

Education :-

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science/ Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.

Ph.D./ Publications or contributions to AI projects/ international journals is a plus

**Qualifications**

AI - Data Science BE/ Btech/ BCA/ Mtech / MBA )
